issues.description: v3-beta default speaker disagrees between docstring/PR description (aditya) and TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS code (shubh).
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag the same contradiction: the dataclass docstring and PR description state v3-beta default speaker is 'aditya', but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. Two sources of truth for one fact, already drifting before merge. Pick one, align both, delete the redundant declaration.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models instead of failing loudly.
issues.detail: Returning v2 speakers for an unrecognized model name invents data and hides bugs — a caller asking about bulbul:v4 gets a confidently wrong answer. Inconsistent with MODEL_CONFIGS which raises on unknown keys. Raise ValueError or return an empty list; do not silently substitute defaults.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT connect_kwargs without justification.
issues.detail: The previous _connect passed 'input_audio_codec' in connect_kwargs; the new version removes it unconditionally with no mention in the PR description. Either a silent regression for v2.5 users on non-default codecs, or an undocumented SDK change. State the why in the commit message or restore it conditionally per ModelConfig.

issues.description: Automatic pace clamping for v3 silently rewrites caller-supplied values.
issues.detail: Pace values outside the v3 range (0.5-2.0) are quietly clamped with no signal to the caller. Silent mutation of caller input is a correctness hazard: pace=3.0 becomes 2.0 invisibly. Either validate-and-reject, or log a warning at clamp time and document the invariant in the setter docstring.

issues.description: ModelConfig dataclass complects capability flags, dispatch tags, and defaults into one record.
issues.detail: ModelConfig mixes supports_prompt/supports_mode/supports_language with default_language/default_mode and use_translate_endpoint/use_translate_method. Validation, dispatch, and defaulting are three orthogonal concerns braided together. The STT and TTS registries also duplicate the same shape across files. Consider splitting concerns and lifting the shared pattern.

issues.description: No tests demonstrate ModelConfig validation, endpoint routing, or parameter rejection.
issues.detail: The point of the ModelConfig table is that set_language/set_prompt/__init__ reject wrong combinations. The PR lists no test additions proving this. Add tests that fail without the patch: prompt-on-saarika raises, language-on-saaras-v2.5 raises, saaras:v3 hits the non-translate endpoint with the mode kwarg.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor from string-sniffing dispatch to a data-driven ModelConfig table is the right direction — dispatch becomes a value rather than scattered control flow. Consensus blockers cluster around three issues all flagged independently: a default-speaker contradiction between docs and code for bulbul:v3-beta, a silent v2 fallback in get_speakers_for_model that invents data for unknown models, and a quietly-dropped input_audio_codec field with no justification. Secondary concerns include silent pace clamping, the complected ModelConfig shape, and missing tests. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — fix the contradictions and add tests before merge.
